bucket1AutoFixesVerified.summary: Aligned ADAPTIVE_COMPLEXITY_LADDER maxTier (6/7/8/10/10) with SCENARIOS 1-10 tier scale and stamped all 32 canonical scenarios across 16/16 bucket_code & Rec..AAA tier_level tags, unlocking previously unreachable tier 6-10 breakouts, 2v1 rushes, regroups, PP Umbrella, PK Box, and goalie reads.

Eliminated falsy `iqScore || 100` coercion across profile creation, syncFromActiveProfile, cloud payloads, and HUD badges so all 24 permutations start cleanly at 0 IQ and accumulate exact Gold (100%), Silver (75%), Streak (+5/+10 IQ), and Redemption (+15 IQ) deltas.
Scheduled rotated/mirrored Play N+3 Redemption Shifts after any missed concept (+15 IQ Gold transfer bonus) and added recentShiftScenarioIds tracking to eliminate within-shift scenario repeats.

Upgraded every scenario to 4 deterministically rotated choice buttons (1 Gold 100%, 1 genuine Silver 75%, 2 educational distractors 0%) and widened defender clearance on basics-defense & d-blueline-walk so Gold lanes are 100% geometrically unambiguous.

Replaced the generic 8U/10U "slide into the slot" wrong-answer fallback with 16 bucket-specific 1-sentence coaching principles (BUCKET_POST_MISTAKE_TEACHING_CUES) so missing Play N explicitly teaches the exact spatial rule needed to solve Play N+3.
